description: Main Roads WA - State Road Network 2018 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Western Australia - Main Roads Western Australia. This layer comprises road centrelines for all roads controlled by Main Roads (state Roads) that are assigned road numbers in the state of Western Australia. The State Road Network are attributed with a road number as identified in Main Roads' corporate Integrated Road Information System (IRIS). Coverage: Government of Western Australia - Main Roads Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Western Australia - Main Roads Western Australia. Its tags are WA, Western Australia, network, polyline, road. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
